title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Barrio School of Capoocan in the City of Calbayog, to “Tiburcio Tancinco Memorial School”

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1957/ra_1634_1957.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The barrio school of Capoocan in the City of Calbayog, shall hereafter be known as "Tiburcio Tancinco Memorial School," in honor of the late Tiburcio Tancinco, who was a Representative from the first district of the Province of Samar and later Judge of the Court of First Instance.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 20, 1957.
